spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands with scattered white clouds over dark ocean; the largest island in the lower right has a pale diffuse trailing haze to its south.

plumes.label: pale gray-blue plume south of the large island
plumes.visual_description: diffuse pale blue-gray haze extending south-southwest from the southern coast of the large island over the ocean, fainter and bluer than the surrounding bright white clouds

evidence: pale gray-blue diffuse haze south of Hawaii island, bluer and fainter than white clouds
SSW extent consistent with NE wind from 30 deg transporting summit emissions to the south-southwest
upwind end SE coast 35.7 km from Kilauea, 69.6 km from Mauna Loa; 31-37 km from Kilauea summit lava thermal clusters (2-4 km from summit), no wildfire source upwind
Kilauea recently eruptive with pause 2 hr before image is plausible vog source; Mauna Loa not erupting

classify.caveats: Kilauea was in episodic_pause, Episode 55 ended at 9:03 a.m. HST ~2 hr before the 11:00 a.m. HST (21:00Z) image, so plume may be residual or passive degassing and emission rate is uncertain. Upwind end is 35.7 km from Kilauea summit on the SE coast, not at the vent, likely due to cloud over the island obscuring the over-land portion and segmentation starting offshore. Visibility is faint, limiting color discrimination. Summit/flank thermal clusters are lava/vent glow, not proof of emissions on their own.

plumes.label: pale gray-blue plume south of the large island

kilauea.activity_summary: Episode 55 of the ongoing Halemaʻumaʻu eruption ended abruptly at 9:03 a.m. HST on October 17, 2026. VAN is being reissued to drop the alert level from WATCH to ADVISORY and the color code from ORANGE to YELLOW.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.

actions.text: Limit outdoor exertion when vog is high; exercise raises effects from gas and particles.
actions.excerpt_en: Limit strenuous activities: Outdoor exercise or exertion increases your chances of being affected by SO2 gas and/or PM2.5. When vog levels are elevated, reduce strenuous activity, if possible.

actions.text: When vog rose, go indoors, close doors and windows, and seal gaps if possible.
